_README: Limits for the global egress gate (mcps/egress-guard/server.py).
This file is the ONLY way to widen a limit. There is no override flag,
no force argument and no bypass environment variable, by design.
Read fresh on every call, so an edit takes effect without a restart.
defaults      applies to any resource not listed under `resources`;
an unknown host auto-registers with these.
resources     per-resource overrides, keyed by exact resource id.
min_interval_s     hard lower bound on the cadence. The effective floor
is the strictest of this and every interval any
participant has declared. A caller can raise it,
never lower it.
window_s           rolling budget window.
max_requests       requests allowed per window. Exhaustion RAISES.
max_cost           cost units allowed per window. One unit is roughly
50 rows, so a `limit: 5000` query debits ~100.
max_wait_s         longest a single acquire may block. Deeper queues are
refused without reserving a slot.
block_cooldown_s   default refusal window after a host pushes back.
86400 = retry tomorrow, not an escalating ladder.
Deleting a resource's file under the state dir resets its ratcheted
floor and its budget history.

_note: robots.txt publishes Crawl-Delay: 2 and documents no per-request
limit for /graphql. 2s is the floor for ONE client; the aggregate is
what tripped the bot challenge, so this is deliberately slower.
Budget sized for a multi-hour crawl at this cadence, not for a burst.
